next_step_summary: PR #261 keeps gemini-3.6-flash as the primary diagnostic model and adds stable gemini-3.5-flash as a fallback only for transient HTTP 503 or read/network timeout failures. HTTP 429 remains a same-model quota/rate-limit retry. The total attempt cap remains 4 per case, and each successful case records the model that actually answered so semantic results are not mixed invisibly. The next step remains local run v3 and review of its generated JSON/TXT before any semantic schema change.
